work.title: Software Engineer
work.description: Improving dnb.com organic discoverability and AI-search visibility through server-side rendering and machine-readable web experiences.
highlights: Increased organic traffic by 10-15% and AI-search citations by 30% by migrating high-traffic dnb.com pages from client-side SPA rendering to server-side rendering, improving crawlability, indexation, and machine readability.

work.title: Associate Software Engineer
work.description: Led CDN, AEM Cloud, developer tooling, automated testing, and frontend performance work across dnb.com.
highlights: Owned routing, caching, DNS, and edge-security controls for dnb.com's production CDN migration from Akamai to Cloudflare, translating complex delivery and security requirements into validated configurations that enabled a successful cutover.

Owned AEM Dispatcher configuration and migration validation for the AEM Cloud replatform spanning 22,000+ pages and 17 markets, enabling AEM authors to publish vanity URLs without individual engineering-maintained redirects.

Cut common AEM debugging workflows from 30-60 minutes to under 5 minutes by building a TypeScript MCP server that connected AI coding assistants to live logs, metadata validation, page inspection, and environment comparison tools.

Accelerated DUNS alphanumeric certification from an expected 3-6 months to 1 month by building an AI-assisted testing framework that converted 200+ Zephyr cases into human-reviewed Cypress/Cucumber tests.

Raised Lighthouse performance scores from approximately 45 to 90 and reduced page-load times by approximately 50% through code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, bundle reduction, and Core Web Vitals fixes, contributing to a 1-2% increase in Marketo lead-form conversions.

work.title: Software Engineering Intern
work.description: Built cloud-native data and AI automation for executive social media and employee sentiment reporting with Google Cloud, LangChain, Terraform, and Power BI.
highlights: Built a nightly Cloud Run pipeline that processed 20,000+ annual social media and Glassdoor data points into Cloud SQL/MySQL for sentiment analysis, risk signals, and executive Power BI dashboards, with automated refreshes through Cloud Scheduler, Terraform, and CI/CD.

Reduced manual reporting work by an estimated 5-10 hours per week by building a LangChain-powered AI sentiment-analysis workflow that automated nightly analysis and Power BI refreshes for executive social media and employee reporting.

work.title: Web Developer Intern
